scope: Development diagnostics only; no locked test, new capture, retraining, threshold change, deployment, or evaluator change.

repeatAtCapture.description: Manifest candidate score versus fresh observedScore at the same commanded pose; not a new R3 Unity run.

matchedPositiveNegative.selection: Nearest opposite-label clean-image pairs on family-disjoint development data at 32x32; labels inspected only after distance selection.

hardFamily0090.componentLimitation: This family stores finalTargetScore only. Exact constituent attribution requires an exclusive Unity pose-restoration diagnostic; none was fabricated.

componentRichHistoricalSameCommandedPose.description: Manifest candidate score versus fresh observedScore at the same commanded pose; not a new R3 Unity run.

g2TemporalSamePoseConsecutive.source: existing G2 temporal capture; diagnostic only

newR3UnityRepeatRun.reason: Existing Unity editor processes were active; protocol forbids terminating or opening the same project concurrently.

recordedExecutedActionTransitions.source: Recorded transitions from the component-rich v4 dataset; uses executedAction/actionWasExecuted, never teacherAction as feedback.
recordedExecutedActionTransitions.limitation: These short transition probes are supplementary causal evidence; their small fixed action set is not an independent recognition benchmark.

priorG0.note: Historical development diagnostic, not fresh heldout evidence.

unityRegression.reason: Exclusive Unity access unavailable; no other Unity process was terminated.

rationale: The exact evaluator total is reproducible from its seven stored components, but several high-weight terms require anatomy raycasts or target/needle/contact geometry unavailable to the image-only actor.
Opposite-label clean images remain close across resolutions, including the known train_family_0090 miss; its active2d schema omits constituent scores, so no anatomical attribution is invented.
Historical temporal evidence improves ranking in one diagnostic, but G2-R2 temporal candidates do not robustly recover the required positives across families.
Finite pairs do not prove mathematical unobservability; the conservative conclusion is partial observability under the current permitted observations and frozen evaluator.
proposedAlternativesRequiringUserReview: Keep the frozen target and explicitly allow simulator-privileged geometry for Phase 2 STOP (changes the image-only product contract).
Define and independently validate an image-observable acquisition target (changes the scientific target/evaluator and requires separate review).
Retain image-only inference but make multi-view uncertainty/abstention a first-class product outcome; this does not guarantee the current 80% recall requirement.
When exclusive Unity access is available, run a small exact-pose component diagnostic for family_0090 and near-boundary controls before selecting an alternative.
